name: Lee Ann Stephenson
occupation: Co-owner of a seasonal campground in Riverside
education: Associate degree, Laramie County Community College, 1987; bachelor’s degree, University of Wyoming, 1989
prior_offices: Carbon County Senior Services Board (10 years); Wyoming Senior Services Board (3 years, appointed); Secretary/treasurer, Sierra Madre Water and Sewer Joint Powers Board; Carbon County Specific Purpose Tax Joint Powers Board
background: Lee Ann Stephenson of Riverside ran in the 2022 primary. She earned an associate degree from Laramie County Community College in 1987 and a bachelor’s degree from the University of Wyoming in 1989. Her professional experience includes co-owning a seasonal campground in Riverside. She served on the Carbon County Senior Services Board for 10 years and was appointed to the state senior services board, where she served for three years. She has also served as secretary/treasurer of the Sierra Madre Water and Sewer Joint Powers Board and on the Carbon County Specific Purpose Tax Joint Powers Board.
